findings.impact: One barrel-to-plane inner defect (drill wander/smear, CAF) at either ACT_GATE via turns Q120/Q121 on with PC1 low, so RAW_ACT follows the pack whenever the board is powered. Firing still needs PE4/Q124 and a static short shows in the passive cold screen (bus sensed live with PC1 low), but it removes one of the two independent controls F8 relies on, and the gate cannot see the hazardous direction because S-8 encodes the N-side rule "GND is safe". The current deviation inventory does not record the In1-GND adjacency of these barrels. No fire from this fault alone; not a demonstrated hardware failure.
findings.concrete_fix: Gate (checks only): give S-8 a per-net hazardous-neighbour set and add the P-FET drive nets: ACT_GATE and ACT_DRV barrels >= 1.0 mm from GND and from every rail below BAT_IN (3V3, 3V3A, PORT_*, VLOGIC, CAM_*), PYRO1_GATE_N / ACT_EN / ACT_EN_MCU barrels >= 1.0 mm from any non-GND copper; add an s04-style seeded regression. Board: either (reviewed CAD change) place R121 and Q122 on B.Cu beside Q120/Q121 so ACT_GATE / ACT_DRV need no layer change and the only via of the enable chain is on ACT_EN_MCU (GND short safe; keep it >= 1.0 mm from non-GND inner copper), or record both ACT_GATE vias with their 0.251 mm In1-GND gap and the cold-screen detection argument in the R10 deviation list.

Focused seeds that a content rule already rejects skip regeneration and run only the relevant stages (hash-bound F9-1 / K-binding staleness is then expected and ignored). kicad-cli 10.0.7 and its bundled pcbnew 10.0.7; NumPy from .supervisor/venv; one kicad-cli process at a time.

Generator stages before r10_post (r10_sch.py, r10_pcb.py, r10_route.py) were not exercised: seeds are post-generation board edits.

kicad-cli / pcbnew 10.0.7 throughout; the installed 10.0.6 was not used. Zone refills by 10.0.7 differ from the saved 10.0.6 fill by a few vertices; the save control (s02) passes every stage, so this does not mask or create a finding.

Temperatures are IPC-2152 curve-fit upper bounds (Inference), not measurements; currents are the project calculations cited. Seeded misses are prospective gate gaps unless stated as current board geometry.
Other lenses (safety, power, routing, ...) were not read (independence rule); overlap with them is possible.
No physical, firmware, supplier or JLC process check. Maker datasheet values are from the cached AOS PDF (Rev 2.1), cited by its maker URL.
